properties.title: German Fourteenth Army: southern approach

properties.title: German Eighth Army: Łódź approach
properties.note: Johannes Blaskowitz’s Eighth Army belonged to Army Group South. Its opening assignment was to advance towards Łódź and protect the northern flank of Tenth Army’s principal thrust.
properties.uncertainty: This arrow represents the opening operational direction, not a road, daily advance limit or troop position.

properties.title: Army Group North · Fedor von Bock
properties.label:
ARMY GROUP NORTH
Bock · 3rd & 4th Armies
properties.note: Bock directed Küchler’s Third Army from East Prussia and Kluge’s Fourth Army from Pomerania. Their tasks included cutting the Corridor, establishing communications with East Prussia and advancing towards the Polish northern interior.
properties.uncertainty: Label placement identifies the broad command sector, not a headquarters or troop location.

properties.title: Army Group South · Gerd von Rundstedt
properties.label:
ARMY GROUP SOUTH
Rundstedt · 8th, 10th & 14th
properties.note: Rundstedt directed Blaskowitz’s Eighth, Reichenau’s Tenth and List’s Fourteenth Armies. Tenth Army carried the main armoured thrust; Eighth protected its northern flank towards Łódź, while Fourteenth advanced through the southern approaches towards Kraków and Galicia.
properties.uncertainty: Label placement identifies the broad command sector, not a headquarters or troop location.

properties.title: Tczew · bridges denied to the attacker
properties.label: Tczew
properties.note: An air and railway operation failed to capture the Vistula bridges intact. Polish defenders demolished them during the morning of 1 September.
properties.uncertainty: Point identifies the locality, not the precise extent of the battlefield, defences or troop positions.

properties.title: Westerplatte · first assaults repulsed
properties.label: Westerplatte
properties.note: The Polish Military Transit Depot resisted the opening bombardment and assaults. The garrison remained in action after the first day and held until 7 September.
properties.uncertainty: Point identifies the locality, not the precise extent of the battlefield, defences or troop positions.

properties.title: Mława · fortified defence
properties.label: Mława
properties.note: The Polish 20th Infantry Division checked frontal attacks by Third Army. Later German outflanking and the wider situation forced withdrawal; the first day did not settle the battle.
properties.uncertainty: Point identifies the locality, not the precise extent of the battlefield, defences or troop positions.

properties.title: Mokra · armour checked
properties.label: Mokra
properties.note: Colonel Julian Filipowicz’s Wołyńska Cavalry Brigade fought dismounted against 4th Panzer Division. Anti-tank guns, woods, the railway embankment and the armoured train Śmiały contributed to repeated checks on the German advance.
properties.uncertainty: Point identifies the locality, not the precise extent of the battlefield, defences or troop positions.
